d: Racers take on a record setting Roadblock by helping build a 13-story bonfire in Norway.
Several teams come together and target one set of Racers at the double U-turn in Italy.

t: Have Fun and Get It Done
d: Teams race through Venice, Italy where one team reaches a breaking point in a frantic search for a water taxi.
While driving to the Detour, one team ends up going the wrong way, and a surprising U-turn causes friction between racers.

t: I Thought We Were Playing It Nice
d: An extreme fear of heights paralyzes one Racer at a Roadblock when faced with bungee jumping 240 feet from a bridge into the Corinth Canal.

t: Riding a Bike is Like Riding a Bike
d: Teams battle the scorching heat while transporting shrimp baskets for one mile to a local fisherman, and one Racer approaches their breaking point during the exhausting Roadblock.
The final four teams race through Seoul, South Korea to clinch a spot in the finale and a chance to race for the one million dollar prize.
